candidates.definition: Candidate recovery witness containing formal address/provenance pointer + Identity Witness + transition token + invariant residue.
candidates.test: Can this bundle uniquely select the correct fine lineage for every declared non-injective handoff fiber?
candidates.result: Fails when its retained fields are not History-separating; may still suffice for implementations whose Identity/Provenance witness already separates the fiber.

candidates.definition: Core candidate plus explicit ordered History trace.
candidates.test: Does adding ordered History resolve counterexamples where the core bundle is ambiguous?
candidates.result: Explicit ordered History separates CE-RW-001; global minimality remains open.

candidates.definition: Retain the fuller predecessor structural state when compressed provenance cannot guarantee unique lineage recovery.
candidates.test: Fallback upper bound on retained structure; not presumed minimal.

candidates.definition: A witness-mediated selector over a handoff merge fiber; it is not an inverse to q_ji and may be partial/context-dependent.
candidates.test: Can the selector recover the declared lineage without inventing distinctions absent from provenance?
candidates.result: Selector is well-defined only on fibers where the retained witness map is separating.

candidates.definition: Return to a prior local presentation with retained distinct History.
candidates.test: Validate against recovered Möbius History and continuity guards.

candidates.definition: Local presentation recurrence does not erase traversal History.
candidates.test: Validate presentation recurrence separately from History equivalence.
